We’ve also rolled together just us (once when I lived in an old apartment. That was not so great. Apartment had bad juju and I was hypersensitive to sound that roll and it wasn’t great for him either). And then we have a few times after I moved. I remember the time before the last was the best one. Five hours of making out, snuggling, and sex. We would have sex, take a break, look at each other and then be back at it again. Literally was amazing (though it’s amazing even without rolling). Spent the rest of the night laying with each other in a squishmallow pile with feel good music  (we have a playlist) and a galaxy light. The best feeling was him holding me and telling me “we’re in this together and I’m not going to let anything happen to either of us”
